description: Begin at the exact installed neutral pose; gently enter the motion.
Gentle coupled knee bend and head dip; return to neutral.
Small head turn and tilt, both feet near neutral; return.
Modest coupled knee bend and nod; return.
Slow bounded head and hip turns; return.
Repeat the small coupled knee bend and head dip.
Ease out of the motion and finish at the exact installed neutral pose.
